name: Burger King Jr. Club
summary:
Join the King Junior Club family today and be enjoy the endless joy.

Burger King Jr Club is the official kids application for Burger King Kuwait where they can enjoy a fun and educational experience at all times.

The application introduces the story of the King Jr Club family as a series of cartoon animated videos. Each one of the King Jr Club family also has his own game where kids get the change to play with him through different interactive activities that tests different skills.

Are you good in memory games? speed games? music games? or math games? Show your skills today to your friends and get your name to the top of the scores board.

In addition to the games, Burger King Jr Club application introduces a rich coloring experience through a gallery of the Jr Club family drawings that are waiting the talented artists to color them! With every update, more drawings are released to make sure there is always some new funny drawings out there! Start coloring today and share your art with your friends through all social media platforms!

Are you a selfie kid? Then it's your time to open the BK Capture Lens, and start taking selfies with the King Jr Club family. Add your favorite stickers and effects, pick your character, and take hilarious pictures.

All of that and more is waiting you there! Download Burger King Jr Club application and let the fun start!
